name: Power and water utilities
description: Operate separate synthetic electricity and water networks and deliver their output to two production buildings.
catalog:
openrepublic-economy 1
resource potable_water
resource electric_parts
utility water
utility power
building water_tower 1 1
  recipe pump every 1 out water:4
end
building waterworks 1 1
  store potable_water 128
  recipe treat every 1 in water:2 out potable_water:2
end
building power_plant 1 1
  recipe generate every 1 out power:4
end
building parts_factory 1 1
  store electric_parts 128
  recipe assemble every 1 in power:2 out electric_parts:2
end
